summary: The pinned CPU diagnostic is suitable for bounded execution. All six source checks pass and all 6536 deterministic evidence checks pass. No diagnostic analysis was executed and no new performance result is approved.

A.name: Ground-truth provenance
A.details: GT comes from the original DepthTrack training dataset path and the SHA-bound training manifest, not model outputs. All 152 files and every GT row were read; original byte hashes, raw row counts, first boxes, frame counts and the exact toy07 truncation match. Frame f maps to GT row f+1 and RGB filename f+1; invalid boxes are unknown and excluded from supervision.

B.name: Score normalization and label arithmetic
B.details: No reported diagnostic is divided by the model's own maxima/minima/means. IoU uses geometric union; MAE/Brier/bin means use valid-sample counts. The Float64 runtime box and Float32 loss-label IoU are intentionally separate. The observation label matches the original clipped-window arithmetic. Prediction-normalized ranking gaps exist only in the historical training loss, not the new reported diagnostic metrics.

C.name: File existence, SHA binding and archived alignment
C.details: All 168 pinned inputs match SHA256; all 154 package entries match byte count and digest; local ZIP matches receipt and all 155 members are identical to extracted files. Both result sequence arrays equal all 456 log rows, with source/spec identities and six observation digest links matched. Exact 666 image metadata keys match the expected historical schedule. New results remain unexecuted; remote image metadata is explicitly qualified.

D.name: Live code paths and side effects
D.details: All six new functions have call sites reachable through main and the CLI guard. The analyzer imports only the standard library, reads only specified local inputs, emits the planned JSON/CSV structures and performs input hash checks before writing a new output directory. Historical neural modules are not imported by this analyzer. No SSH/network/model/optimizer/progress-query path exists in the new analyzer.

E.name: Full versus sparse scope
E.details: Each arm has 152 sequences, seed 2027 and three complete training passes: 456 sequence runs, 659406 calls, 610128 valid supervision frames and 20421 optimizer updates. GT validity and 32-call accumulation blocks independently reproduce ledger call/supervision/update counts. The union contains 912 ledger rows and 3996 sparse state records at 666 unique sequence/frame pairs. All scope boundaries are correctly stated; no generalization or all-write rate is claimed.

F.name: Evaluation type and claim boundaries
F.details: Intended evaluation is a real-GT historical training diagnostic. It is not official benchmark evaluation, synthetic proxy or proof of visibility/identity. Center exclusion, geometric nonintersection and invalid GT remain distinct; changing training weights, sparse observations, CPU arithmetic and absent causal controls are disclosed. No text/module/template efficacy or final VOT claim is supported by this source audit.

claim_limits: Source audit only: the planned analyzer was not imported or executed, and no new IoU, quality-calibration, observation-calibration, severe-error or sampled-write diagnostic results were produced.

Ground-truth origin is supported by the original training manifest, trainer, exporter, byte-identical local files and archive. This audit did not independently authenticate the dataset publisher or read the remote dataset.
Image dimensions and image hashes are sealed remote CPU-export metadata. The 666 source RGB image byte streams are absent locally and were not independently decoded by this reviewer.
Full log counters cover the complete training histories; selected-box IoU, quality errors, observation Brier scores and write-quality counts use only the deterministic sparse sample schedule.

Sample means and bins weight retained valid sampled states equally. They are neither a per-sequence macro average nor an unbiased full-frame/full-write population estimate; short sequences/endpoints and 500-frame write-eligible times have different sampling weights. Stratification or retrospective weighting alone would not reveal unrecorded states.
The two arms use seed 2027 with three training passes each. They are two configurations, not independent seeds; the six summaries and 3,996 states are dependent repeated training observations.

Historical predictions use changing model parameters during optimization. They do not establish fixed-final-checkpoint or held-out DepthTrack/CDTB/VOT performance, robustness, benchmark superiority or model selection.

Quality calibration is for the selected cell on retained valid-GT states, not all 256 candidate cells or the full quality-training BCE. Observation labels mean geometric GT-box/window intersection, not physical target visibility, semantic identity or physical absence.
GT-center exclusion and GT-box/window nonintersection are different events. Invalid GT is unknown and is excluded from geometric/quality targets, never treated as an absence/identity-negative label.
CPU Float32 overlap is a source-matched arithmetic reimplementation; no bitwise GPU replay or neural checkpoint re-execution was performed.

Full template-write totals are recorded counters; sparse samples cannot establish all-write error rates or template contamination/causal damage. No text, module or template causal effect follows from these logs.

The reused training_spec.json is an M82 dataset/order/GT manifest, not a complete M122 optimizer/configuration description. M122 learning rate, weight decay, three passes and updates are established by its own source and sealed result files.

The historical observation and source gate were read locally. This audit did not query current server/GPU progress, rehash remote sources, reopen model weights, or certify completion of the ongoing VOT evaluation.

deterministic_checks.counting_unit: One named boolean assertion; row assertions combine multiple schema/integrity conditions. These are not independent statistical trials.

action_items: No source changes are required by this audit. Run only the pinned diagnostic under the existing authorization, preserve the declared limits, then audit actual outputs before claiming or publishing new diagnostic numbers.
tooling_notes: A preliminary PowerShell listing command had a parser error before reading its batch; the corrected read-only listing succeeded.

A reviewer-side JSON output split failed after supplemental read-only checks; the corrected serialization was read successfully. Neither tooling issue executed the subject analyzer or modified inputs.
